narrative.introduction: The Sweet Flavor Ontology catalogs canonical culinary sweeteners, syrups, honey products, natural and alternative sweeteners, and cocoa or chocolate ingredients used worldwide in cooking. This domain models culinary ingredients, not desserts, confectionery, beverages, recipes, or commercial brands.
narrative.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary sweeteners and sweet flavor ingredients by group — usage intensity, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
narrative.summary: Canonical culinary sweet flavor ingredients across six immutable groups: Sugars, Syrups, Honey & Bee Products, Natural Sweeteners, Alternative Sweeteners, and Cocoa & Chocolate Ingredients.
